EmailTemplate.subject: Thank You
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear [Insert Name],
Thank you so much for partnering with the American Red Cross and participating in the Future Blood Donor program. We are truly grateful for your commitment of time and support. The work you do makes a difference to so many in need.
The blood drive you held on [date] resulted in [number] units of blood. Your efforts have helped boost the community blood supply and ensure hospital patients have the lifesaving blood on which they depend.
Not only did you make a difference in the lives of patients, but you made a difference in the lives of your students as well. You provided them a platform to learn more about the importance of donating to those in need as well as the opportunity to utilize their leadership skills by recruiting donors. We hope they enjoyed the rewarding feeling of saving lives with the Red Cross.
The Red Cross depends on the important work that volunteers like you do. Your support does not go unnoticed and we hope to build on this partnership with you.
Sincerely,
[Insert Name]
